Work complete, left uncommitted in the worktree per instructions.

**Files created/changed:**
- `src/packages/local-observability/src/uds/inboxServer.ts` (new) — ports `mn`, `nn`, `$e`, `W`, `hn` (wired to `m9r`/`removeActiveKeyFileSync`), and `_m` as `MessagingStartError`, plus internal helpers `Oe`, `gn`, `pn`.
- `src/packages/local-observability/src/uds/bind.ts` — completed `clearActiveInbox` (`H`) and `closeInbox` (`B`) to match the reference's full shutdown behavior (settle held messages via `dbt`, flush idle notices, remove the published key, unwire the five session cables).
- `src/packages/local-observability/src/uds/udsMessaging.ts` — `startUdsMessaging` now calls the real `mn` with process-wide default dependencies instead of the stub.
- `.env.example` — added `THYROX_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN` with its file comment.
- `__tests__/udsF2Server.test.ts` and `__tests__/udsF2Close.test.ts` (new) — the seven required scenarios plus anulación-verified guards.

**Verification:** `tsc --noEmit` clean (build + test configs, including `noUnusedLocals`/`noUnusedParameters`), full package suite 973/973 green (no regressions vs. baseline), the `@thyrox/cli` consumer typechecks against the new signatures, and three representative guards (the `settleHeld` branch in `B`, the `IL` path check in `mn`, one of `H`'s five nulling calls) were each verified by anulación — removing each one broke exactly the tests that depend on it, no more, no less.
